allowed_evidence: charter catalog and charter text with authenticity notes
archaeological excavation and scientific dating records
national monument and historic-environment text records
gazetteer point coordinates with stated licence
terrain, hydrography and route data that do not depict historical territories

candidate_entities.label: Mercian kingship under Offa
candidate_entities.status_rule: Eligible only where interval-applicable evidence identifies Mercian authority; Offa’s general title does not assign every locality.

candidate_entities.label: Powys
candidate_entities.status_rule: Retrospective or post-window evidence may establish a candidate polity but cannot become a 780–796 locality control without an explicit continuity claim.

candidate_entities.label: Gwynedd
candidate_entities.status_rule: The 798 royal notice is bracketing context only unless independent evidence supports continuity into the target interval.

contested_features.activation_rule: No allocation role is permitted until a supported, interval-applicable claim establishes that role for a specified section. A later traversal or corridor role must be isolated as a sensitivity scenario; a hard political split is not permitted.

deviation_policy: Any post-freeze change requires a versioned amendment committed before affected analysis and reported beside the primary result. After any held-out body is opened, changes to research inputs, model choices, candidate priority, evaluation units or denominator are post hoc and cannot replace the preregistered result.
expected_failure_modes: the interval is mistakenly presented as a day-precise political state
Welsh polity names or continuity remain insufficient for local control
raid, battle, tribute or royal title is promoted to continuous control
dyke sections of different dates or functions are collapsed
modern or later place names are mismatched to early medieval referents
a binary allocation erases a frontier or unknown zone
sparse locality evidence makes projection, grid or calibration dominate
held-out map chronology, scale or ontology does not match the preregistered question
held-out author and modeling evidence share an unrecognized source lineage
lawful access to a source or comparator becomes unavailable
the held-out map expresses fewer than six locked units
thumbnail, snippet or OCR leakage contaminates the seal
automated checks are mistaken for proof of a human browsing history

held_out_evaluation.denominator_rule: Evaluate every locked unit as aligned, not_aligned, not_expressed or not_comparable. Report aligned/(aligned+not_aligned) together with all four counts; never remove an unfavorable locked unit after opening.
held_out_evaluation.interpretation_rule: Fewer than six expressed comparable units yields inconclusive comparator. Any agreement rate is map agreement under the frozen rubric, never historical accuracy or ground truth.
held_out_evaluation.isolation_rule: Candidate maps remain metadata-only and outside sources, observations, claims, model decisions, scenarios and spatial inputs. Candidate order cannot change after any map body is opened.
held_out_evaluation.opening_gate: A second reconstructed_pre_evaluation Git commit must freeze the evidence bundle, scenarios, code version, calibration, reconstruction outputs, fixed place coordinates, evaluation rubric and hashes before first body access.

lineage_rules.claim: A claim lists supporting and challenging observations, temporal and spatial scope, semantic role and status. Point control never implies an area, and a cross-year bridge must be disputed, unresolved or explicitly argued.
lineage_rules.model_decision: Only supported claims may authorize admitted inputs. Every scenario explicitly lists included and excluded decision IDs. Natural or engineered geometry supplies location only; its historical role requires a separate claim, and model defaults remain assumptions.
lineage_rules.observation: One observation records one locatable statement or measurement. Event location, participants, outcome, engineering location and gazetteer coordinates are separate observations; uncertainty is retained.
lineage_rules.source: Every research source must use an allowed evidence class and record a stable locator, access scope, rights status and access date. Historical territorial maps exist only in the separate held-out register.

prior_information_disclosure: Before this freeze, the feasibility team read the non-map textual and archaeological records listed in source-access-rights.json and summarized them in feasibility-audit.json.
No existing historical territorial map body, thumbnail, PDF page, image, vector, OCR or screenshot was opened, downloaded or parsed.

Search results exposed textual bibliographic descriptions for candidate atlases. A Shepherd atlas result also exposed a map-label summary; that candidate is excluded as metadata-snippet-tainted and is not registered.
The feasibility evidence is prior information and remains visible in the initial bundle; it must not be reported later as post-freeze discovery.
prohibited_evidence: historical territorial map bodies, thumbnails, screenshots, OCR or derivatives before the evaluation gate
territorial polygons or boundary vectors traced or inferred from a held-out map
unsourced web-map labels or search snippets used as evidence
raid, battle, tribute, title or dyke location promoted directly to continuous territorial control
model defaults or calibration values presented as historical evidence
research_question: Within the Rhuddlan–Dee/Llangollen–Chirk–Oswestry/Llanymynech–upper Severn corridor during 780-01-01 through 796-07-29, which named localities can non-territorial-map evidence support as Mercian-controlled, controlled by a named Welsh polity, contested, or unresolved, and how sensitive would any later boundary hypothesis be to preregistered treatments of Offa’s Dyke?

spatial_scope.exclusion_rule: Exclude southern dyke reaches beyond the upper Severn, Britain-wide territorial inference, and any geometry or assertion copied or inferred from an existing historical territorial map.
spatial_scope.inclusion_rule: Include named places, routes, terrain and recorded earthwork sections inside the bounding box, plus textual relations that explicitly bear on those referents during the target interval.
spatial_scope.name: Northern and central Mercia–Welsh frontier corridor from Rhuddlan to the upper Severn

stop_conditions: Stop and record NO_RECONSTRUCTION when the post-freeze budget is exhausted without the reconstruction gate.
Stop searching a gap once its success criterion is met or two targeted follow-ups fail to add admissible evidence.
Stop immediately and record a protocol deviation if held-out content is exposed before the second pre-evaluation freeze.
Do not add evidence, alter parameters or change the evaluation denominator in response to held-out results.

success_criteria.evaluation_gate: A valid lineage-bearing reconstruction and all locked evaluation inputs are frozen in a second Git commit; the primary candidate is opened first and all outcomes, including an inconclusive comparator, are reported without tuning.
success_criteria.phase_one: A conditional GO audit, a metadata-only held-out register, a frozen preregistration, a non-reconstruction case skeleton and passing isolation tests. No polygon is required or permitted.
success_criteria.reconstruction_gate: At least two modeled entities each have two independent, legally accessible, interval-applicable named-locality relations; at least eight distinct spatial candidates derive from three independent source lineages; at least one counterevidence or exclusion relation is retained; every admitted record has a stable locator and clear rights. Otherwise the registered result is NO_RECONSTRUCTION.

temporal_scope.bridge_rule: Year-only evidence may apply to the interval but never to a precise day. Evidence outside the interval is contextual only and may enter an interval claim solely through an explicit, reviewable continuity or bracketing argument; otherwise it remains unresolved.
temporal_scope.cutoff_event: Offa’s death on 796-07-29 closes the terminal Offan evidence window.
